# MUS-W-0001

<!-- Generated by `mustur export`. Do not hand-edit: `mustur verify` fails on drift, and the store is the record. -->

**An identifier scheme records can be addressed by**

work-unit · 2026-08-19

Discharges: [MUS-M-0002](../milestones.md#mus-m-0002)

Decided by: [MUS-D-0022](../decisions.md#mus-d-0022)

## Context

Every record Mustur holds needs a permanent name before the first insert, because the store is append-only and records cite each other by name.

## Depends on

Nothing.

## Discharges

Part of MUS-M-0002: records addressable by identifier.

## Done means

An identifier parses into project, role and serial, or is rejected with a message naming the canonical form.
A role letter that disagrees with the record's kind is an error at validation, not at render time.
Two records sort the same way in every listing Mustur produces, asserted by a test over the sort.
A serial of zero and a serial past four digits are both rejected.

## Risks

The four-digit serial is a ceiling. Widening it later would resort every identifier written before it, so the field is fixed rather than grown; ten thousand records of one role in one project is the point at which this unit was wrong.
The three-letter project prefix is assigned by hand. Two projects choosing the same prefix collide silently until they are in the same store, which is the day of the first onboarding.
